rec: Yanille teleport or Nightmare Zone minigame teleport
Cooking gauntlets for lower burn chance on monkfish
rewards: Access to the Piscatoris Fishing Colony

st.t: Talk to Herman Caranos outside the Piscatoris Fishing Colony, north of fairy ring AKQ.
s: I'm a brave adventurer! Can I try?

st.t: Talk to the Wise Old Man in Draynor Village.
s: You used to be a famous adventurer, didn't you?

st.t: Talk to the Wise Old Man outside the Fishing Colony. Be prepared to fight sea trolls.
If you aren't inside the Fishing Colony yet, enter through the hole next to the Wise Old Man. Kill the sea trolls.
Go into the building in the east of the Fishing Colony and talk to Herman. Tap the floor inside the building first, as tapping Herman from outside can send you running around to the north.
Talk to Franklin in the middle of the Fishing Colony.
Add some logs to the firebox in the building with a furnace.
Light the logs in the firebox in the building with a furnace.
Flatten 5 iron bars using the metal press.
Repair all 5 broken walls to the west, using an iron sheet on each. If you have no hammer, tell Franklin you have the iron sheets and he will give you one.
Talk to Franklin again.
Talk to Arnold at the bank in the Fishing Colony.

Fish at least 5 fresh monkfish at the fishing spot in the north-west of the colony, using a small fishing net (Arnold gives you one if you have none). Sea Trolls will appear, and you'll need to kill them.
Cook 5 monkfish on the stove in the kitchen, south of the fishing spot. If you burn any, catch some more.
Bring the monkfish to Arnold at the bank.
Talk to Herman in the east of the colony again.

r: Cooking gauntlets for lower burn chance on monkfish

st.t: Talk to Wizard Frumscone in the Wizards' Guild basement.
s: I'll see what the necromancer needs me to do.

st.t: Talk to Malignius Mortifer, south of Falador and north of Port Sarim, a little north-west of Betty's magic shop.
s: I need help with saving a fishing colony.

st.t: Wear the brown apron Malignius gave you to enter the Crafting Guild, then talk to the Master Crafter with dreadlocks on its east side.
Add a pot lid to a pot.
Bring the airtight pot and 7 bones to Malignius Mortifer near Port Sarim. Make sure you're equipped for the fight before speaking to Malignus.
s: I've spoken to the master crafter...

tr: Yanille teleport or Nightmare Zone minigame teleport

st.t: Be prepared to fight, and talk to Herman in the colony.
Kill the Sea Troll Queen.
s: No, I'm ready to move on with the quest.

st.t: Talk to Herman to finish the quest.
